answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the ivory solution is checked at the haven gate and logged, the basalt audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 22 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. The fee repeats 12 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
